definition: per run a fresh app; at first frame + 10s attach one `pitwall mcp --project` session (initialize, initialized, tools/list, stdin held open) or do nothing (control), then sample the app instance's phys_footprint (responsible-pid group: app + WebKit) every 10s up to 60s; a run's value is the median of its samples from 40s after attach; 1 warm-up (control), then 5 session/control pairs alternating
